info.name: Discord - Cyberpunk | Neon
info.description:
Midnight-blue glass, electric cyan text, magenta selections and violet
lighting give Discord a cyberpunk terminal look. A 40 px grid and faint
CRT scanlines show through the translucent side panels. The theme styles
chat, the composer, navigation, Friends and member lists, popups, menus
and settings. Chromium scrollbars use a cyan-to-magenta gradient.
